name: ambiguous-catalog-identity
query: The catalog lists a free NVIDIA model, but the configured route uses a different provider identity. Update everything automatically.
expected_behavior: Separates catalog identity from configured provider identity.
Stops for a discrepancy report when the exact route is ambiguous.
Does not silently substitute or enable the route.
failure_signs: Maps direct NVIDIA NIM to an OpenRouter-hosted model without proof.
Uses a paid route to make the task complete.
